question: Mein Chef möchte, dass wir regelmässig bis 23 Uhr arbeiten. Braucht er dafür eine spezielle Bewilligung von den Behörden, und dürfen wir als Mitarbeiter dazu etwas sagen?
key_facts: Work between 20:00 and 23:00 is considered evening work and does not require an official permit (bewilligungsfrei).
The employer can introduce evening work after consulting the employee representation or, if none exists, the affected employees.
An individual employee's day and evening work (including breaks and overtime) must fall within a time window of 14 hours.
must_not: State that the employer must obtain an official permit from the authorities to introduce evening work.
notes: Silver: generated from ArG Art. 10 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis en désaccord avec une décision prise directement par le Conseil fédéral. Est-ce que je peux faire un recours auprès du Tribunal fédéral pour la faire annuler ?
key_facts: Acts of the Federal Council and the Federal Assembly generally cannot be brought before the Federal Supreme Court.
Exceptions to this rule can only be provided by federal law.
must_not: The Federal Supreme Court automatically reviews any decision of the Federal Council on appeal.
notes: Silver: generated from Cst. Art. 189 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Nel mio contratto di lavoro è scritto che se voglio licenziarmi io devo dare tre mesi di preavviso, mentre il datore di lavoro può licenziarmi con solo un mese di preavviso. È legale una clausola del genere?
key_facts: Notice periods cannot be different for the employer and the employee.
If different notice periods have been agreed upon, the longer notice period applies to both parties.
must_not: The shorter notice period automatically applies to both parties.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 335a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: There is a major defect in my rented apartment that limits how I can use it. Can I demand a reduction in rent, and from which point in time?
key_facts: A tenant can demand a proportional rent reduction if the property's suitability for its intended use is impaired or reduced.
The rent reduction applies from the moment the landlord learned of the defect until the defect is remedied.
must_not: Claim that the rent reduction applies retroactively to when the defect first occurred, even if the landlord was not yet aware of it.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 259d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich habe einen Wegweisungsentscheid erhalten und muss die Schweiz verlassen. Welche Pflichten oder Auflagen können mir die Behörden jetzt noch bis zu meiner Ausreise auferlegen?
key_facts: The competent authority can require you to report regularly to an authority.
The authority can require you to deposit travel documents.
The authority can demand that you provide an appropriate financial security (bail/deposit).
must_not: The authorities are automatically required to take your travel documents in every case.
notes: Silver: generated from AIG Art. 64e (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon médecin est-il obligé de respecter des règles spécifiques de qualité pour que ses soins continuent d'être remboursés par mon assurance maladie de base ?
key_facts: Healthcare providers are required to comply with quality development rules established in quality agreements (or determined by the Federal Council if no agreement is reached).
Compliance with quality development rules is an explicit condition for providers to practice at the expense of the compulsory health care insurance (AOS).
must_not: Claim that quality agreements are optional guidelines that do not affect the reimbursement of treatments by the compulsory health insurance.
notes: Silver: generated from LAMal Art. 58a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Vivo all'estero e percepisco degli interessi su un'ipoteca legata a un immobile in Svizzera. Se chiedo che questi interessi vengano versati sul conto di un'altra persona, devo comunque pagarci le imposte alla fonte in Svizzera?
key_facts: Taxable income for mortgage creditors residing abroad consists of the gross proceeds from the relevant claims.
Interest payments count as taxable income even if they are not paid directly to the person subject to withholding tax, but to a third party.
must_not: Diverting or paying the interest to a third party exempts the income from withholding tax.
notes: Silver: generated from OIFo Art. 17 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I have received a removal order to leave Switzerland. How much time will I normally be given to leave, and can this period be extended?
key_facts: A reasonable departure period between 7 and 30 days is normally granted with the removal order.
A longer departure period must be set, or the period extended, if special circumstances require it, such as family situation, health issues, or a long duration of stay.
The departure deadline can be less than 7 days, or the removal executed immediately, under specific circumstances such as posing a threat to public security or a risk of absconding.
must_not: Claim that the departure deadline can never exceed 30 days under any circumstances.
notes: Silver: generated from AIG Art. 64d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mir gehört ein Grundstück. Wie weit reicht mein Eigentum eigentlich in die Höhe und in die Tiefe, und gehören mir auch die Pflanzen und Quellen darauf?
key_facts: Ownership of land extends upwards into the airspace and downwards into the ground as far as there is an interest in exercising the ownership.
Subject to statutory restrictions, land ownership includes all buildings, plants, and springs on the property.
must_not: Land ownership extends infinitely into the sky and to the center of the earth without any limitation to the owner's interest.
notes: Silver: generated from ZGB Art. 667 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon médecin m'a proposé un nouveau traitement médical controversé dont l'efficacité est encore en cours d'évaluation. L'assurance maladie de base peut-elle quand même le rembourser ?
key_facts: The Federal Council (or the department/office it delegates to) determines to what extent compulsory health insurance covers the costs of a new or controversial treatment whose effectiveness, appropriateness, or cost-effectiveness is under evaluation.
notes: Silver: generated from LAMal Art. 33 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I live in France but work in Switzerland as a cross-border commuter and have Swiss health insurance. If I need inpatient hospital treatment in Switzerland, does a Swiss canton help pay for my hospital bill?
key_facts: Swiss cantons co-finance inpatient hospital treatment alongside health insurers for cross-border commuters residing in an EU member state, Iceland, Norway, or the UK (and their family members) who are treated in Switzerland.
The canton's share must be set at a minimum of 55 percent.
The canton pays its share directly to the hospital (unless the canton and insurer agree that the canton pays the insurer to forward the full amount).
must_not: The patient's health insurer must cover 100 percent of the inpatient costs without any cantonal contribution.
notes: Silver: generated from KVG Art. 49a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich ziehe bald als deutscher Staatsbürger in die Schweiz, werde dort nicht arbeiten und habe gehört, dass man sich nach dem Aufwand pauschal besteuern lassen kann. Welche Voraussetzungen muss ich dafür erfüllen und wie wird diese Steuer berechnet?
key_facts: To qualify, you must not have Swiss citizenship, must not carry out any gainful employment in Switzerland, and must be subject to unlimited tax liability in Switzerland for the first time or after an absence of at least 10 years (both spouses must meet these criteria if living together).

The tax replacing the income tax is based on annual living expenses in Switzerland and abroad, but must at least equal the highest amount among: a cantonal minimum, seven times the annual rent/rental value (for those with their own household), or three times the annual pension board costs (for others).
The expenditure-based tax must be at least as high as the ordinary taxes calculated on specific Swiss gross assets and income (such as Swiss real estate, Swiss movable capital, or Swiss pensions).
must_not: You cannot be taxed on expenditure if you hold Swiss citizenship or if you engage in any gainful employment in Switzerland.
notes: Silver: generated from StHG Art. 6 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis dans ma troisième année de travail dans mon entreprise et je viens de tomber malade. Mon patron a-t-il le droit de me licencier pendant mon arrêt maladie, et qu'arrive-t-il s'il le fait ?
key_facts: After the probation period, an employer cannot terminate the contract during an incapacity to work caused by illness (not due to the employee's fault) for 90 days during the second to fifth year of service.
A notice of dismissal given during this protected period is null and void (invalid).
If notice was already given before the illness, the notice period is suspended during the illness and resumes running only after the protected period ends.
must_not: The employer can fire the worker at any time during an illness as long as they pay compensation.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 336c (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mio cugino gestisce una ditta individuale e non rispetta le regole minime di sicurezza per i dati dei clienti, e penso persino che trasmetta i dati all'estero senza autorizzazione. Rischia delle sanzioni penali?
key_facts: Private individuals who intentionally violate data protection obligations regarding minimum data security requirements or unauthorized disclosure of personal data abroad can be punished with a fine.
The fine can be up to 250,000 Swiss francs.
Prosecution requires a formal complaint (querela di parte).
must_not: The authorities prosecute these violations automatically without requiring a complaint.
notes: Silver: generated from LPD Art. 61 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: What responsibilities does an AHV compensation office handle directly for insured individuals and employers?
key_facts: Compensation offices determine, reduce, waive, and collect social security contributions, as well as collect administrative cost contributions.
They assess and pay out pensions and helplessness allowances (Hilflosenentschädigungen).
They maintain individual accounts, issue assessment decisions, and carry out reminder and debt enforcement proceedings.
must_not: Pensions are determined and paid out directly by the Federal Council rather than the compensation offices.
notes: Silver: generated from AHVG Art. 63 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon entreprise va introduire le chômage partiel le mois prochain. Quelles sont les obligations de mon employeur concernant le paiement de mes indemnités et mes cotisations sociales ?
key_facts: The employer must advance the compensation and pay it to the employees on the usual payday.
The employer must continue to pay full social insurance contributions as if the working hours were normal.
The employer is authorized to deduct the employees' full share of the social contributions from their salary, unless agreed otherwise.
must_not: The employer can reduce social insurance contributions proportionally to the reduced working hours.
notes: Silver: generated from LACI Art. 37 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Devo affrontare una causa legale ma non ho abbastanza soldi per pagare le spese e un avvocato. Posso ricevere un aiuto dallo Stato?
key_facts: A person who lacks the necessary financial means is entitled to free proceedings, provided their case does not seem to lack chances of success.
A person is also entitled to free legal representation (a lawyer) if having a lawyer is necessary to protect their rights.
must_not: Legal aid and free representation are granted unconditionally regardless of whether the case has a chance of success.
notes: Silver: generated from Cost. Art. 29 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I deposited my rent with an official authority because my landlord won't fix defects in my apartment. How long do I have to bring my claims before the conciliation authority before the money is released to my landlord?
key_facts: You must bring your claims against the landlord before the conciliation authority within 30 days of the due date of the first deposited rent payment.
If you fail to bring your claims within this 30-day period, the deposited rent is released to the landlord.
must_not: You have 60 days to submit your claims to the conciliation authority.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 259h (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin arbeitslos und möchte mich selbstständig machen. Welche Voraussetzungen muss ich erfüllen, um während der Planungsphase von der Arbeitslosenkasse gefördert zu werden, und muss ich mich in dieser Zeit weiter bewerben?
key_facts: To be eligible, the insured person must be unemployed through no fault of their own, be at least 20 years old, and submit a rough project (Grobprojekt) for taking up a viable and permanent self-employed activity.
During the planning phase, the insured person does not need to be available for job placement (vermittlungsfähig) and is exempt from the obligations under Article 17 (such as job-seeking efforts).
must_not: You still have to actively search for regular jobs and be available for placement during the planning phase.
notes: Silver: generated from AVIG Art. 71b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon propriétaire veut augmenter mon loyer en disant que ses coûts ont augmenté. Quelles dépenses peuvent légalement être considérées comme des hausses de coûts pour justifier cette augmentation ?
key_facts: Increases in mortgage rates, taxes, property taxes, building leasehold interest (rentes de droits de superficie), insurance premiums, and maintenance costs are considered cost increases.
Costs resulting from the alienation (sale/transfer) of the property are deemed part of the acquisition costs and are not considered cost increases.
must_not: Costs resulting from the sale or alienation of the property can be passed on as cost increases.
notes: Silver: generated from OBLF Art. 12 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Vorrei fare un periodo di volontariato o lavorare come ragazza alla pari per un datore di lavoro all'estero mentre mi trovo in Svizzera. Questo conta legalmente come lavoro dipendente?
key_facts: Any activity performed for an employer based in Switzerland or abroad is considered gainful employment (dipendente), regardless of whether the salary is paid in Switzerland or abroad.
Activities carried out on an hourly, daily, or temporary basis are considered gainful employment.
Roles such as volunteers, au pairs, interns, apprentices, athletes, social workers, missionaries, religious consultants, and artists are explicitly deemed gainful employment.
must_not: Claim that voluntary work or being an au pair is exempt from being considered gainful employment if it is unpaid or for a foreign employer.
notes: Silver: generated from OASA Art. 1a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I pay tax at source in Switzerland, but I want to apply for a regular tax assessment instead. What is the deadline to submit the application, and can I cancel it if I change my mind?
key_facts: You must submit the written application to the competent tax authority by March 31 of the year following the tax year.
Once submitted, the application cannot be withdrawn.
must_not: You can withdraw the application if the regular tax assessment results in a higher tax burden.
notes: Silver: generated from QStV Art. 10 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon mari vient de décéder alors qu'il travaillait pour la même entreprise depuis plus de 20 ans et avait 54 ans. L'entreprise doit-elle me verser une indemnité pour ses longues années de service ?
key_facts: An employer must pay an indemnity for long service when the employment of a worker who is at least 50 years old ends after 20 years or more of service.

If the worker dies during the employment relationship, this indemnity must be paid to the surviving spouse or registered partner (or to minor children, or failing that, to other persons the worker had a maintenance obligation towards).
must_not: Claim that the indemnity is lost or cancelled upon the employee's death.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 339b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho una piccola impresa con alcuni dipendenti. Chi ha il diritto di venire a controllare se sto rispettando le regole per i contributi AVS?
key_facts: The compensation fund (cassa di compensazione) periodically checks whether affiliated employers comply with legal provisions.
The check can be carried out by a qualified auditing company/lead auditor, a specialized service or organization of the compensation fund, or an insurer/executive body of another social insurance.
notes: Silver: generated from LAVS Art. 68b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: What penalties could I face if my organization uses people's AHV numbers systematically without authorization, or without having proper security measures in place?
key_facts: Systematic use of the AHV number without being authorized to do so is punished with a monetary penalty (Geldstrafe).
Using the AHV number without taking the required technical and organizational measures is punished with a fine (Busse).
must_not: Failing to implement required security measures is punished with imprisonment.
notes: Silver: generated from AHVG Art. 153i (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich habe von meinem Arbeitgeber gesperrte Mitarbeiteraktien zu einem vergünstigten Preis erhalten. Wie wird dieser Vorteil als Einkommen versteuert und wird die Sperrfrist dabei berücksichtigt?
key_facts: Monetary benefits from employee shares are taxable as income from employment at the time of acquisition.
The taxable benefit is the market value of the shares minus any acquisition price paid.
For blocked employee shares, a discount of 6 percent per blocking year is deducted from the market value, up to a maximum of ten years.
must_not: Blocked employee shares are only taxed at the time they are sold or when the blocking period expires.
notes: Silver: generated from StHG Art. 7d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'habite en France mais je viens de commencer un travail en Suisse et je n'ai pas encore souscrit d'assurance maladie suisse. Que risque-t-il de se passer si je tarde trop ?
key_facts: Les cantons informent les personnes résidant dans l'UE/AELE/Royaume-Uni et travaillant en Suisse sur leur obligation d'assurance.
L'autorité désignée par le canton affiliera d'office la personne à une assurance si elle ne s'assure pas en temps utile.
Cette autorité cantonale statue également sur les demandes d'exception à l'obligation de s'assurer.
must_not: Claim that the employer is responsible for affiliating the cross-border worker automatically.
notes: Silver: generated from LAMal Art. 6a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: L'ufficio migrazione mi ha fatto firmare un accordo di integrazione per il mio permesso di dimora. Cosa succede se non riesco a rispettare gli obiettivi fissati?
key_facts: If an integration agreement is not respected, the authorities will examine whether there is a valid reason for the non-compliance when deciding on extending or revoking the permit.
Without a valid reason for non-compliance, the authorities will balance public interests against your personal situation to decide on extending or revoking the permit.
must_not: The residence permit is automatically revoked immediately without any examination of reasons or personal circumstances.
notes: Silver: generated from OASA Art. 77g (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My landlord just sold the apartment building I live in. Can the new owner kick me out, and what happens to my lease?
key_facts: The lease automatically transfers to the new owner along with the ownership of the property.

For residential premises, the new owner may terminate the lease using the statutory notice period for the next statutory date if they can claim an urgent personal need for themselves, close relatives, or in-laws.
If the new owner terminates the lease earlier than the contract with the previous landlord would have permitted, the previous landlord is liable to the tenant for all resulting damage.
must_not: The sale automatically cancels the existing lease agreement.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 261 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich führe ein Unternehmen und möchte wissen, für welche Fälle ich steuerwirksam Rückstellungen in meiner Erfolgsrechnung bilden darf und was passiert, wenn der Grund dafür wegfällt.
key_facts: Provisions to the debit of the income statement are allowed for existing obligations of uncertain amount, risks of loss on current assets (especially goods and debtors), other directly impending risks of loss in the business year, or future R&D contracts to third parties (up to 10% of taxable profit, max. 1 million CHF).
Previous provisions that are no longer justified are added back to taxable profit.
must_not: Provisions for future research and development contracts to third parties can be made without any percentage or maximum financial limit.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 63 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je travaille à l'étranger dans une multinationale qui souhaite me transférer temporairement dans sa filiale en Suisse en tant que spécialiste. Quelles sont les conditions pour obtenir une autorisation de séjour dans ce cadre ?
key_facts: The intra-company transfer must involve senior management (cadres supérieurs) or indispensable specialists within an international company.
The exchange must serve the economic interests of Switzerland and have an application submitted by the employer.
It must comply with quota limits (maximum numbers), working and wage conditions, and suitable accommodation requirements.
must_not: State that any general employee of an international company can qualify regardless of being a senior executive or indispensable specialist.
notes: Silver: generated from OASA Art. 46 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My Swiss spouse and I live in different places for work reasons, but we are still happily married. Does this separate living arrangement disqualify me from applying for citizenship through my marriage?
key_facts: A marital community requires both a formal marriage and an actual shared community of life where the mutual will for a stable marriage remains intact.
Living together is not required if there are valid/important reasons for maintaining separate places of residence, provided the marital community continues to exist.
The marital community must exist both at the time of the citizenship application and at the time of naturalisation.
must_not: Living at separate addresses automatically disqualifies a spouse from naturalisation.
notes: Silver: generated from BüV Art. 10 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Il mio datore di lavoro si trova attualmente in servizio militare e tocca a me sostituirlo nelle sue mansioni fino al suo rientro. Ho già terminato il periodo di prova; posso dare le dimissioni in questo momento?
key_facts: After the probation period, an employee cannot terminate the employment relationship if the employer or a superior is prevented from working due to the conditions in Art. 336c para. 1 let. a (such as compulsory military/civilian service).
This restriction applies if the employee is able to assume the functions of the employer/superior and must take over those duties for the duration of the impediment.
The provisions of Art. 336c paragraphs 2 and 3 apply analogously to such a termination.
must_not: State that the employee has an unconditional right to resign at any time after the probation period even when taking over the employer's essential duties during their absence.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 336d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Can my employer withhold part of my salary each payday as security, and if so, how much are they allowed to keep?
key_facts: An employer may only withhold a portion of your wage if it was agreed upon, is customary, or is stipulated by a standard or collective employment contract.
Unless a standard or collective employment contract states otherwise, the employer can withhold no more than one tenth of the wage due on any single payday.

The total withheld amount cannot exceed the wage for one working week (unless higher retention is set by a standard or collective employment contract), and it serves as security for the employer's claims rather than a contractual penalty.
must_not: An individual agreement between employer and employee can exceed the maximum limit of one week's wage.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 323a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich möchte unsere Familienwohnung kündigen, aber mein Ehepartner weigert sich, die Kündigung zu unterschreiben. Was kann ich tun?
key_facts: A spouse may only terminate the lease of a family home with the express consent of the other spouse.
If the consent cannot be obtained or is withheld without a valid reason, the spouse seeking to terminate the lease can appeal to a judge.
must_not: One spouse can unilaterally terminate the lease of a family home without the other's consent or a court decision.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 266m (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis suisse et je viens d'avoir un enfant avec ma compagne étrangère, mais nous ne sommes pas mariés. Notre enfant aura-t-il la nationalité suisse ?
key_facts: A minor foreign child whose Swiss father is not married to the mother acquires Swiss citizenship once the legal filiation (paternity) with the father is established.
Once filiation is established, the child acquires Swiss citizenship as if they had acquired it at birth.
must_not: The child automatically becomes Swiss at birth even if paternity is never legally established.
notes: Silver: generated from LN Art. 1 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Sto guidando in città e mi trovo dietro a un tram fermo alla fermata: da che parte devo superarlo e come devo comportarmi?
key_facts: A stationary tram or street railway may only be overtaken slowly.
It must be overtaken on the right if there is a boarding platform (banchina).
If there is no boarding platform, it must only be overtaken on the left.
must_not: You are always free to overtake a stopped tram on either side regardless of whether there is a platform.
notes: Silver: generated from LCStr Art. 38 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Is my basic health insurance provider legally allowed to process my sensitive medical information and data about my financial situation?
key_facts: Bodies responsible for administering basic health insurance are legally authorized to process personal data, including sensitive personal data, needed to fulfill their statutory tasks.
They are specifically authorized to process data that allows the assessment of the insured person's health, the severity of physical or mental illness, needs, and economic situation.
This processing is permitted for specific statutory purposes, such as assessing and granting benefits, calculating premiums or premium reductions, and enforcing mandatory insurance.
must_not: They are completely prohibited from looking at sensitive health data without prior written consent for every claim.
notes: Silver: generated from KVG Art. 84 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mein Vermieter will die Miete mit der Begründung erhöhen, sie sei an die orts- und quartierüblichen Mietzinse anzupassen. Anhand welcher Kriterien wird eigentlich bestimmt, ob eine andere Wohnung mit meiner vergleichbar ist?
key_facts: To determine local and neighborhood customary rents, the comparison properties must be comparable in terms of location, size, furnishings/equipment, condition, and construction period.
Official statistics must be taken into account.
Rents that result from market dominance by a landlord or group of landlords must not be considered.
notes: Silver: generated from VMWG Art. 11 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai appris que les autorités préparent un contrat-type de travail pour mon secteur professionnel. Est-ce que j'ai le droit de donner mon avis avant qu'il ne soit adopté ?
key_facts: Before a standard employment contract (contrat-type de travail) is enacted, it must be published with a deadline for comments.
Anyone who can demonstrate or justify an interest has the right to submit written observations within that deadline.
must_not: Only professional associations and public utility societies are allowed to give their opinion.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 359a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Il proprietario della casa in cui vivo in affitto dice che dopo la consegna tocca a me occuparmi di mantenere l'appartamento in buono stato, e c'è una clausola nel contratto a riguardo. È legale?
key_facts: The landlord is obligated to deliver the rented property at the agreed time in a condition fit for its designated use and to maintain it in that condition for the duration of the lease.
Clauses that deviate from this rule to the disadvantage of the tenant in residential or commercial leases (or in pre-formulated standard terms) are null and void.
must_not: The landlord can validly transfer the general obligation to maintain the residential property in a usable state to the tenant via standard contract clauses.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 256 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: If inflation goes up, does the federal government adjust income tax brackets and deductions so I don't pay more tax just because of inflation?
key_facts: The effects of bracket creep (cold progression) on individual income tax are fully offset by adjusting tax brackets and fixed-franc income deductions.
The Federal Department of Finance adjusts these brackets and deductions annually based on the consumer price index as of June 30 before the tax period.
Adjustments are rounded to the nearest 100 francs, and no adjustment is made if inflation is negative.
must_not: Tax brackets and deductions are adjusted even when inflation is negative.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 39 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je n'y connais rien aux impôts et j'aimerais qu'un ami s'occupe de mes démarches fiscales à ma place. Est-ce que j'ai le droit de désigner la personne de mon choix pour me représenter ?
key_facts: A taxpayer can be represented before tax authorities as long as their personal cooperation is not strictly necessary.
Any person who has the exercise of civil rights and enjoys civic rights can act as a representative.
The tax authority can require the representative to prove their authority by providing a written power of attorney (procuration écrite).
must_not: Only a certified fiduciary, accountant, or licensed lawyer is legally authorized to represent you before the tax authorities.
notes: Silver: generated from LIFD Art. 117 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Lavoro a tempo pieno per circa 8 ore al giorno. A quante pause ho diritto per legge e queste pause contano come orario di lavoro?
key_facts: The daily work must be interrupted by a break of at least half an hour if it lasts more than seven hours (or at least an hour if it lasts more than nine hours).
Breaks count as working time only if the employee is not allowed to leave their workstation.

question: I earn a very small salary from a side job, and my employer says they don't have to deduct social security contributions because of the low amount. Can I insist that they pay AHV contributions on my wages anyway?
key_facts: Even if the law allows wages up to the maximum monthly retirement pension to be exempt from contributions, the employee can in any case demand that the employer pays the contributions.

question: Quali informazioni personali è tenuto a registrare su di me l'ufficio controllo abitanti del mio Comune?
key_facts: The inhabitants' registers must contain at least basic personal identifiers such as the AHV/AVS number, official surname, all given names, date and place of birth, sex, marital status, and citizenship (or place of origin for Swiss citizens).

They record address and housing details, including the building/dwelling identifiers from the federal register, household type, arrival/departure dates and locations, or relocation dates within the municipality.

For foreigners, the register also includes the type of residence permit, and for all residents it includes data such as religious affiliation (if recognized) and voting/eligibility rights (federal, cantonal, municipal).

question: I have refugee status in Switzerland. Am I allowed to visit my home country, or travel to countries neighbouring it?
key_facts: Refugees are prohibited from traveling to their country of origin or homeland.

If there is a well-founded suspicion that the travel ban will be disregarded, the State Secretariat for Migration (SEM) can issue travel bans for additional countries, particularly neighbouring countries, for all refugees from that origin country.

question: Wann darf mein Chef verlangen, dass ich über die gesetzliche Höchstarbeitszeit hinaus arbeite, und wie viele Überstunden darf ich maximal an einem Tag machen?
key_facts: The statutory maximum weekly working hours may only be exceeded exceptionally, such as due to urgency, extraordinary workload, inventory/accounting/liquidation work, or to prevent/remedy operational disruptions.
Overtime work (Überzeit) must not exceed two hours per day for an individual employee, except on non-working weekdays or in emergencies.

key_facts: Les autorités relèvent les empreintes digitales de tous les doigts et prennent une image faciale des étrangers séjournant illégalement dès l'âge de 6 ans.
Les données enregistrées dans Eurodac sont automatiquement détruites cinq ans après la saisie des données biométriques.

question: Vorrei avviare un servizio di trasporto locale con veicoli a guida autonoma senza conducente: a quali condizioni generali possono essere autorizzati a circolare?
key_facts: I veicoli a guida autonoma senza conducente possono circolare solo su tratti prestabiliti e sotto la sorveglianza di un operatore.
Il Cantone d'immatricolazione stabilisce caso per caso i tratti e le eventuali condizioni supplementari.
Se i tratti interessano più Cantoni serve l'accordo tra i Cantoni coinvolti, mentre per le strade nazionali serve l'accordo con l'USTRA.

notes: Silver: generated from LCStr Art. 25c (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Darf eine Bundesbehörde meine Kontaktdaten und mein Geburtsdatum an jemanden herausgeben, der einfach danach fragt, auch wenn es dafür eigentlich keine gesetzliche Grundlage gibt?
key_facts: Federal bodies are generally permitted to disclose a person's first name, surname, address, and date of birth upon request even if the standard statutory grounds are not met.
The federal body must refuse, restrict, or attach conditions to the disclosure if essential public interests or obviously legitimate interests of the person concerned require it.
Disclosure must also be refused or restricted if statutory duties of secrecy or special data protection provisions require it.
must_not: Claim that federal bodies are strictly prohibited from disclosing basic contact information without prior consent or a formal statutory basis.
notes: Silver: generated from DSG Art. 36 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je dois bientôt faire du service militaire. Est-ce que j'ai le droit de toucher une allocation pour mes enfants pendant cette période, et jusqu'à quel âge ?
key_facts: A person performing service is entitled to a child allowance for their children or for foster children they support and raise permanently and free of charge.
The allowance is granted for children who have not yet reached their 18th birthday.
For children who are in an apprenticeship or in studies, the right to the allowance lasts until they turn 25.
must_not: State that the child allowance is only available for biological children.
notes: Silver: generated from LAPG Art. 6 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho un permesso di domicilio in Svizzera ma devo trasferirmi all'estero per un periodo senza dichiarare subito la partenza. Quanto tempo posso stare via prima che il mio permesso scada?
key_facts: If leaving Switzerland without notifying departure, a settlement permit (permesso di domicilio) expires after six months.
Upon request, the settlement permit (permesso di domicilio) can be maintained for up to four years.
must_not: State that the settlement permit expires after three months without notification of departure.

question: Ich vermiete eine Ferienwohnung an ausländische Gäste. Welche Pflichten habe ich bezüglich der Registrierung dieser Personen?
key_facts: Anyone accommodating a foreign national for payment must fill out a registration form (Meldeschein) based on the guest's identification document.
The accommodated person must present their identification document and sign the registration form.
The completed registration form must be submitted to the competent cantonal authority.
must_not: Claiming that guests do not need to show an ID or sign the registration form.
notes: Silver: generated from VZAE Art. 18 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon conjoint et moi venons d'accueillir un enfant en vue de son adoption. Pouvons-nous prétendre à une allocation d'adoption, et comment cela fonctionne-t-il si nous adoptons ensemble ?
key_facts: The adopted child must be under 4 years old.

The person must have been insured under the AHV/AVS for at least 9 months prior to taking in the child, have worked for at least 5 months during that period, and be currently employed or self-employed (or work in the spouse's business for a cash wage).
In the case of a joint adoption, both parents must meet the eligibility conditions, but only one overall allowance right is granted (which can be shared if they share the leave).
must_not: Claiming that adopting a spouse's or registered partner's child gives entitlement to an adoption allowance.
notes: Silver: generated from LAPG Art. 16t (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin das ausländische Kind eines Schweizer Elternteils, erfülle aber die Bedingungen für den normalen Familiennachzug nicht mehr. Kann ich trotzdem eine Aufenthaltsbewilligung in der Schweiz bekommen und hier arbeiten?
key_facts: A residence permit can be granted if there is a possibility of reintegration (Wiedereinbürgerung) or simplified naturalisation (erleichterte Einbürgerung) under the Swiss Citizenship Act.
Employed work can be permitted if there is an application from an employer, wage and working conditions are met, and suitable housing is available.
Self-employed work can be permitted if the necessary financial and operational requirements are met and suitable housing is available.
must_not: You can never get a residence permit if you do not qualify for ordinary family reunification.
notes: Silver: generated from VZAE Art. 29 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis rémunéré à la tâche et mon employeur m'a confié un travail sans m'indiquer le tarif à l'avance. Comment mon salaire doit-il être calculé ?
key_facts: The employer must inform the employee of the wage rate before the start of each piece or task work.
If the employer fails to inform the worker beforehand, the wage must be paid according to the rate set for identical or similar work.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 326a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho appena cambiato casa in Svizzera: quanto tempo ho per aggiornare l'indirizzo sulla patente di guida e a chi devo comunicarlo?
key_facts: You must notify the competent authority of your new domicile within 14 days of changing residence.
The notification must include your new address.
must_not: You have 30 days to notify the authority of the address change.
notes: Silver: generated from OAC Art. 26 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I just received the annual heating bill from my landlord, but it only shows a lump sum without any details. Do I have the right to see the full breakdown and the actual receipts?
key_facts: If the annual bill does not include a detailed breakdown and allocation of heating and hot water costs, it must explicitly state that the tenant can request a detailed statement.
The tenant (or their authorised representative) is entitled to inspect the relevant original supporting documents.
The tenant has the right to demand information regarding the opening and closing stocks of heating materials.
must_not: The landlord only has to provide a breakdown if the tenant requests it before the annual bill is issued.
notes: Silver: generated from VMWG Art. 8 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich habe die Frist zur Einreichung meiner Steuererklärung verpasst und inzwischen eine Mahnung erhalten. Mit welchen Bussen muss ich rechnen, wenn ich sie weiterhin nicht einreiche?
key_facts: Failing to submit the tax return despite a reminder (intentionally or negligently) is punished with a fine.
The fine is generally up to 1,000 francs.
In severe cases or in the event of a repeat offense (Rückfall), the fine can be up to 10,000 francs.
must_not: Claim that the maximum fine can exceed 10,000 francs under this provision.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 174 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Dans quelles situations les autorités suisses peuvent-elles retirer la nationalité à quelqu'un pour atteinte grave aux intérêts ou au renom du pays ?
key_facts: Une atteinte grave aux intérêts ou au renom de la Suisse implique la commission de crimes spécifiques, tels que des crimes graves liés au terrorisme, à l'extrémisme violent ou au crime organisé, ou encore des crimes de guerre, génocides ou crimes contre l'humanité.
Le retrait présuppose en principe une condamnation pénale entrée en force.

Une exception à l'exigence de condamnation entrée en force existe si la poursuite pénale ne peut pas aboutir parce que l'État où les actes ont été commis ne veut pas ou ne peut pas mener la procédure ou répondre à l'entraide judiciaire.
must_not: Une simple infraction mineure ou une condamnation pour un délit ordinaire suffit à retirer la nationalité suisse.
notes: Silver: generated from OLN Art. 30 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Lavoro come commesso viaggiatore stagionale e la mia retribuzione dipende per più di un quinto dalle provvigioni, che variano molto a seconda della stagione. Se sono rimasto al lavoro anche dopo la fine della scorsa stagione, con quanto preavviso può licenziarmi il mio datore durante la nuova stagione?
key_facts: When commission makes up at least one-fifth of the salary and is subject to significant seasonal fluctuations, special termination rules apply.
A commercial traveller who worked after the end of the previous season can only be dismissed during the new season for the end of the second month following the month of notice.
must_not: Claim that the employer can dismiss the commercial traveller immediately or with only one month of notice.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 350 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Can my state pension (AHV) be seized for debts, or can the authorities deduct money from it?
key_facts: The entitlement to a pension is exempt from debt enforcement (cannot be seized).
Authorities can offset due pension payments against certain claims under the AHV, disability insurance (IV), loss of earnings compensation, or agricultural family allowances.

Pensions can also be offset against repayment claims for supplementary benefits (EL) or repayments of pensions and daily allowances from mandatory accident, military, unemployment, or health insurance.
must_not: State pensions can be seized by private creditors through standard debt enforcement procedures.

question: Ich bin selbstständig erwerbend. Für welche Fälle darf ich in meiner Buchhaltung steuermindernde Rückstellungen bilden?
key_facts: Provisions can be charged to the income statement for existing obligations from the financial year whose amount is not yet determined.
Provisions are allowed for loss risks associated with current assets (especially goods/inventory and accounts receivable) or other directly impending loss risks of the financial year.
Provisions can be made for future research and development orders assigned to third parties, up to 10 percent of taxable business income, capped at a maximum of 1 million francs.
must_not: Claims that provisions for third-party research and development contracts are unlimited in amount.

question: Il mio medico può farmi pagare una cifra più alta rispetto alla tariffa ufficiale concordata per una prestazione coperta dall'assicurazione di base?
key_facts: Healthcare providers must adhere to the tariffs and prices set by agreement or by the competent authority.
Providers are prohibited from demanding higher remuneration for benefits covered by the law (tariff protection).
If a provider opts out of providing benefits under this statutory framework, they must formally declare this refusal and inform the patient in advance, receiving no remuneration under the law.
must_not: A healthcare provider who operates under the standard mandatory health insurance framework can charge extra fees directly to the patient above the official tariff.

question: What kind of expenses can my landlord actually include on my annual heating and hot water bill?
key_facts: Only actual expenses directly related to the operation of the heating or central hot water system may be charged.

Allowable costs include fuel/energy consumed, electricity for burners and pumps, chimney/heating cleaning and waste removal, periodic servicing/descaling, meter reading/billing services, maintenance, insurance exclusively covering the heating system, and administrative work related to the system.
Maintenance and administrative costs may be charged based on actual expenditure or according to standard rates.
must_not: The landlord can charge general building insurance premiums as heating costs.
notes: Silver: generated from VMWG Art. 5 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich habe eine Bewilligung für bestimmte Arbeitszeiten in meinem Betrieb, schaffe es aber derzeit nicht, alle Vorgaben daraus einzuhalten. Welche Konsequenzen drohen mir durch die Behörden?
key_facts: The licensing authority can revoke the working time permit after a prior written warning.
If the circumstances justify it, the authority can block the issuance of new permits for a specified period.
must_not: The authority can immediately revoke the permit without any prior written warning.

question: Mon enfant est tombé gravement malade et j'aimerais savoir quels critères légaux définissent le fait qu'un enfant est « gravement atteint dans sa santé » pour ouvrir droit au congé de prise en charge.
key_facts: The child must have suffered a major change in their physical or mental health.
The progression or outcome of this change must be difficult to predict, or expected to lead to lasting or increasing impairment, or death.
The child requires increased care from a parent, and at least one parent must interrupt their gainful employment to care for the child.

key_facts: The allowance is for parents of a minor child with severe health problems due to illness or accident.
The parent must interrupt their gainful employment to care for the child.
At the time of interruption, the parent must be an employee, self-employed, or working in their spouse's business for a cash wage.

key_facts: The usufructuary is liable for the destruction and depreciation of the property unless they prove the damage occurred without their fault.
Items that were consumed must be replaced if their consumption was not part of the normal use.
The usufructuary does not have to compensate for any reduction in value caused by the proper, ordinary use of the property.

notes: Silver: generated from ZGB Art. 752 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin EU-Bürger und lebe mit einer Aufenthaltsbewilligung in der Schweiz. Darf mein Ehepartner auch zu mir ziehen und hier arbeiten, selbst wenn er kein EU-Bürger ist?
key_facts: Regardless of their nationality, spouses of individuals who are nationals of a contracting party and have a right of residence are considered family members and have the right to reside with them.
The spouse has the right of access to economic activity (gainful employment) regardless of their nationality.
The residence permit issued to the family member has the same validity as the one of the person from whom the right is derived.

key_facts: Provisional arrest under Article 19 paragraph 3 of the Federal Act on Administrative Criminal Law is excluded in these proceedings.
must_not: Provisional arrest is permitted if the tax authorities suspect active complicity.

key_facts: Driving licences for special categories G and M are issued after passing the basic theory exam (esame teorico di base).
A practical driving test is not required for categories G and M according to Art. 24 para. 2 (subject to Art. 28 para. 2).
must_not: state that a practical driving test is required for special categories G and M
notes: Silver: generated from OAC Art. 24 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I live across the border in an EU country but work in Switzerland as a cross-border commuter. Can I get a reduction on my Swiss health insurance premiums if I have a low income?
key_facts: Cantons grant premium reductions to insured cross-border commuters (and their family members) who live in an EU member state, Iceland, Norway, or the UK.
The entitlement requires the person to be in modest economic circumstances (bescheidene wirtschaftliche Verhältnisse).
must_not: Claim that premium reductions are only available to people who reside inside Switzerland.

question: Ich möchte eine Fachkraft aus dem Ausland für meine Firma einstellen. Gibt es in der Schweiz Obergrenzen für neue Arbeits- und Aufenthaltsbewilligungen und wer legt diese fest?
key_facts: Der Bundesrat kann Höchstzahlen für erstmalige Kurzaufenthalts- und Aufenthaltsbewilligungen zur Erwerbstätigkeit für den Bund und die Kantone festlegen.
Vor der Festlegung von Höchstzahlen muss der Bundesrat die Kantone und die Sozialpartner anhören.

question: Je suis étranger et je touche des prestations complémentaires. Est-ce que le service qui me verse ces aides va automatiquement le signaler au service cantonal de la population ou de la migration ?
key_facts: The authorities responsible for supplementary benefits must spontaneously notify the cantonal migration authorities when an annual supplementary benefit is paid to a foreign national.
Reimbursement of illness and disability costs must also be reported if the total amount exceeds 6,000 francs per calendar year.
The report must include personal details (name, date of birth, nationality, address) and the amount of the benefit, and must be sent within 20 days.
must_not: The authorities only report supplementary benefits if the migration office explicitly requests the information.
notes: Silver: generated from OASA Art. 82d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My siblings and I recently inherited an estate that generates rental income. Is the community of heirs taxed as a separate entity, or do we have to pay taxes on this income individually?
key_facts: The income earned by a community of heirs is not taxed as a separate entity; instead, it is attributed proportionally to the individual heirs.

key_facts: Applicants living abroad must have close ties to Switzerland (eng mit der Schweiz verbunden sein).

Applicants living abroad must respect public security and order, respect the values of the Federal Constitution, and not pose a threat to Switzerland's internal or external security (applied mutatis mutandis).

question: En tant qu'employeur soumis à une convention collective, est-ce que les syndicats et associations patronales peuvent s'unir pour me forcer directement à respecter la convention et me réclamer des pénalités ?
key_facts: Associations that concluded a collective agreement can stipulate that they jointly have the right to enforce compliance against employers and workers bound by it.

Joint enforcement can cover rules on individual employment contracts (though only through a declaratory action), contributions to compensation funds, employee representation, industrial peace, as well as controls, deposits/guarantees, and contractual penalties relating to those matters.

notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 357b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

key_facts: Cantonal migration authorities can enforce your departure or removal without formalities if you were already expelled by a Schengen state for not meeting entry conditions.

Before executing the removal to your country of origin or provenance, the cantons must verify whether the enforcement is still admissible, reasonably exigible, and possible, and issue a formal decision.

question: I just lost my job and got paid out for untaken overtime and leftover vacation days. Will this payout reduce or delay the loss of work counted for my unemployment benefits?
key_facts: You are entitled to have your loss of work counted in full (without reduction) even if you received compensation for untaken overtime hours.
Receiving a vacation payout upon ending your employment (or having holiday pay included in your salary) also does not reduce the crediting of your loss of work.
must_not: Unemployment benefits will be reduced or delayed to account for payouts of unused vacation or overtime.

question: Meine Firma plant eine Massenentlassung und hat mich gekündigt. Ab wann ist meine Kündigung eigentlich genau wirksam, und muss die Firma das irgendwo offiziell melden?
key_facts: The employer must notify the cantonal employment office (Arbeitsamt) in writing about the planned mass dismissal and provide a copy to the employee representation or the employees.

If an employment relationship is terminated as part of a mass dismissal, it ends 30 days after notification to the cantonal employment office, unless the termination takes effect at a later date under contractual or statutory provisions.

notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 335g (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

key_facts: A maximum of 98 daily allowances can be paid within the framework period.
When both parents work, each parent is entitled to at most half of the daily allowances by default.
The parents can agree to split the allowances differently between themselves.
must_not: Parents are strictly obligated to split the days 50/50 without any possibility to agree otherwise.

question: Ich habe eine eigene GmbH gegründet. Wie oft muss ich für die Gewinnsteuer einen Geschäftsabschluss machen und was gilt dabei als Steuerperiode?
key_facts: The tax on net profit (Reingewinn) is assessed and levied for each tax period, which corresponds to the business year (Geschäftsjahr).
A financial statement consisting of a balance sheet and income statement must be prepared in every calendar year, except in the year of foundation.
A financial statement is also required upon relocation (of registered seat, administration, business operation, or permanent establishment) or upon completion of liquidation.
must_not: A company must always prepare a financial statement in the calendar year it was founded.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 79 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis travailleur frontalier en Suisse et je vais bientôt changer d'employeur. Quelles démarches dois-je effectuer et dans quel délai ?
key_facts: Cross-border commuters (frontaliers) must report any change of job to the competent authority at their place of work.
The notification must be made before starting the new job.
must_not: You can notify the authority within a few days or weeks after starting your new job.
