question: Lavoro come badante convivente e vivo a casa del mio datore di lavoro da pochi mesi. Cosa è tenuto a garantirmi il datore di lavoro per legge riguardo a vitto e alloggio, e cosa succede se mi ammalo?
key_facts: If the employee lives in the employer's household, the employer must provide sufficient board (food) and suitable/impeccable lodging.
If the employee is prevented from working due to illness or accident through no fault of their own, the employer must provide care and medical treatment for a limited time.

During the first year of employment, the employer must provide care and medical treatment for three weeks (and for an appropriately longer period thereafter depending on the duration of employment and circumstances).
must_not: The employer is not required to provide medical care or treatment if the employee falls ill in the first year of service.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 328a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Can I take out daily allowance sickness insurance, and do I have to use the same insurance company as my mandatory health insurance?
key_facts: To take out daily allowance insurance, you must reside or be gainfully employed in Switzerland and be between the ages of 15 and 65 (having reached your 15th birthday but not yet your 65th).
You are allowed to choose a different insurer for daily allowance insurance than the one you use for your mandatory health insurance.
must_not: You must take out daily allowance insurance with the same insurer that provides your mandatory healthcare insurance.
notes: Silver: generated from KVG Art. 67 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin ins Ausland gezogen und habe nun gesperrte Mitarbeiteroptionen aus meiner früheren Tätigkeit in der Schweiz ausgeübt. Muss ich diesen Vorteil in der Schweiz versteuern und wenn ja, zu welchem Satz?
key_facts: Persons resident abroad when receiving monetary benefits from blocked employee stock options are liable to tax in Switzerland proportionally (pursuant to Art. 17d).
The tax rate is 11.5 percent of the monetary benefit.
must_not: Claiming that living abroad exempts the recipient entirely from Swiss direct federal tax on these blocked employee options.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 97a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'envisage d'acheter une voiture avec conduite automatisée. Puis-je désactiver la « boîte noire » qui enregistre le mode de conduite, et que garde-t-elle exactement en mémoire ?
key_facts: The driving mode recorder cannot be deactivated.

It records and timestamps events such as when the automated system is activated, deactivated (and the reason), when the driver is prompted to take over control, safety-critical maneuvers, or important safety failures.
The recorded data cannot be modified, and older data is overwritten once storage capacity is reached.
must_not: The driver or owner can disable the driving mode recorder at any time in the vehicle settings.
notes: Silver: generated from LCR Art. 25f (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Lavoro come badante e vivo a casa del mio datore di lavoro. Il fatto che mi offra vitto e alloggio può essere considerato parte del mio stipendio?
key_facts: If the employee lives in household communion with the employer, board and lodging (room and board) forms part of the salary.
Board and lodging does not count as part of the salary if there is an agreement or custom to the contrary.
must_not: Board and lodging can never be deducted or considered as part of the salary under Swiss law.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 322 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Wie wird mein Beitrag an die Arbeitslosenversicherung bezahlt, und muss ich mich selbst darum kümmern?
key_facts: The employer deducts the employee's contribution share directly from each wage payment.
The employer pays both the employee's and employer's share together to the relevant AHV compensation fund (AHV-Ausgleichskasse).
Employees of employers who are exempt from paying contributions must pay their own contributions directly along with their AHV contributions to their AHV compensation fund.
notes: Silver: generated from AVIG Art. 5 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ricevo le indennità di perdita di guadagno: devo pagarci sopra i contributi per le assicurazioni sociali come l'AVS o l'AI, e chi si fa carico di questi costi?
key_facts: Contributions for Old-Age and Survivors' Insurance (AVS/AHV), Disability Insurance (AI/IV), the loss of earnings scheme (IPG/EO), and if applicable unemployment insurance must be paid on the compensation.
Half of the social security contributions are borne by the entitled beneficiary and the other half by the compensation fund (Fondo di compensazione delle indennità di perdita di guadagno).
must_not: The beneficiary has to pay 100% of the social security contributions on the compensation.
notes: Silver: generated from LIPG Art. 19a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My neighbor just built a shed that partially encroaches onto my land without my permission. What can happen if I don't object to it in time?
key_facts: If you fail to object in good time even though the encroachment was recognizable, the encroaching neighbor may be granted an in rem right to the encroaching structure or ownership of the encroached land.
The neighbor must have acted in good faith for the court to grant them the right to the structure or the land.
If the right or land ownership is awarded to the neighbor, you must receive appropriate compensation.
must_not: You automatically forfeit all rights and receive no compensation if you fail to object in time.
notes: Silver: generated from ZGB Art. 674 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mein Betrieb möchte sich einem Gesamtarbeitsvertrag anschliessen, aber die geforderten Beiträge für den Beitritt scheinen uns völlig überrissen. Können wir uns dagegen wehren?
key_facts: A judge can declare unreasonable accession conditions, particularly unreasonable financial contributions, null and void or reduce them to a permissible level.
Provisions or agreements establishing contributions for the sole benefit of an individual contracting party are automatically null and void.
must_not: State that contracting parties can set accession fees and contributions at any amount without any judicial oversight.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 356b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: J'ai développé une nouvelle invention au travail, mais cela ne faisait pas du tout partie de mes tâches prévues par mon contrat. Mon employeur peut-il récupérer mon invention et ai-je droit à une compensation ?
key_facts: The employer can only claim a right to inventions made outside contractual obligations if there is a written agreement reserving that right.
The employee must notify the employer in writing, and the employer has six months to inform the employee in writing whether they wish to acquire the invention.
If the employer decides to acquire the invention, they must pay the employee a fair special compensation taking into account all relevant circumstances.
must_not: The invention automatically belongs to the employer even without a written agreement when it is outside the employee's contractual obligations.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 332 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho fatto domanda per ottenere il condono delle mie imposte, ma temo che possa essere rifiutata. Quali sono i motivi principali per cui il fisco può respingere la mia richiesta?
key_facts: Tax remission (condono) can be refused in whole or in part if the taxpayer seriously or repeatedly violated tax procedure obligations, making it impossible to assess their financial situation for that period.
It can be denied if the taxpayer had the means but failed to set aside reserves or failed to make payments when the tax debt became due.

It can be denied if the taxpayer caused their own inability to pay (e.g., voluntarily giving up income/assets, living beyond their means, reckless behavior) or prioritized other creditors during the assessment period.
must_not: Tax remission is always granted automatically whenever a taxpayer is currently in financial difficulty.
notes: Silver: generated from LIFD Art. 167a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I am provisionally admitted to Switzerland (F permit) and want to move to another canton. How do I apply, and under what conditions can I get permission to move?
key_facts: You must submit an application for a change of canton to the State Secretariat for Migration (SEM), which will consult the affected canton.
A move will be approved to protect family unity or in the case of a serious threat to the health of the provisionally admitted person or other persons.

A move can also be approved for a permanent job or basic vocational training in the other canton, provided you and your family do not receive social assistance and the job has lasted at least 12 months (or staying in the current canton is unreasonable due to commute or working hours).
must_not: You can freely move to another canton without applying to the SEM as long as you register with the local municipality.
notes: Silver: generated from AIG Art. 85b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich vermiete eine Wohnung und habe erfahren, dass mein Mieter in Konkurs geraten ist. Welche Rechte habe ich nun bezüglich der künftigen Mietzahlungen und des Mietvertrags?
key_facts: The landlord can demand security for future rent payments if the tenant goes bankrupt after taking possession of the property.
The landlord must set an appropriate deadline in writing to both the tenant and the bankruptcy administration to provide this security.
If no security is provided within the set deadline, the landlord may terminate the lease without notice.
must_not: The landlord can terminate the lease immediately upon bankruptcy without first setting a deadline to provide security.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 266h (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je gère une association à but d'utilité publique. Si notre association est exonérée d'impôts, cette exonération couvre-t-elle également l'impôt sur les gains immobiliers en cas de vente d'un bien ?
key_facts: Legal entities pursuing public utility or public service goals are exempt from tax on profit and capital exclusively and irrevocably dedicated to those goals.
However, these public utility legal entities remain subject to the real estate capital gains tax (impôt sur les gains immobiliers) in all cases.
must_not: Claim that tax-exempt public utility entities are exempt from paying tax on real estate capital gains.
notes: Silver: generated from LHID Art. 23 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Il mio permesso di soggiorno è scaduto da poco ma sono ancora in Svizzera e sto continuando a lavorare senza un'autorizzazione. Cosa rischio a livello penale?
key_facts: Soggiornare illegalmente in Svizzera (incluso dopo la scadenza del soggiorno autorizzato) o esercitare un'attività lucrativa senza permesso è punito con una pena detentiva fino a un anno o con una pena pecuniaria.
Se la violazione è commessa per negligenza, la sanzione prevista è una multa.
must_not: La pena detentiva può arrivare fino a tre anni.
notes: Silver: generated from LStrI Art. 115 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I am an asylum seeker in Switzerland. Can I get permission to take up temporary employment, and what are the conditions?
key_facts: Asylum seekers may be granted permission for temporary employment if the asylum law requirements are met.
Permission depends on the economic and labour market situation and requires an application from an employer.
Standard wage and working conditions must be respected, local worker priority must be observed, and the applicant must not be subject to a legally binding expulsion order.
must_not: Asylum seekers are automatically entitled to work without an application from an employer.
notes: Silver: generated from VZAE Art. 52 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Welche Aufgaben hat die Arbeitslosenkasse eigentlich genau mir gegenüber, und wer entscheidet, wenn bei meinem Anspruch Unklarheiten bestehen?
key_facts: Die Arbeitslosenkasse klärt die Anspruchsberechtigung ab (sofern dies nicht ausdrücklich einer anderen Stelle vorbehalten ist) und zahlt die Leistungen aus.
Die Kasse verfügt Einstellungen in der Anspruchsberechtigung, soweit diese Befugnis nicht der kantonalen Amtsstelle zusteht.
Bestehen Zweifel über die Anspruchsberechtigung oder eine Einstellung (ob, für wie viele Tage oder ab welchem Zeitpunkt), kann die Kasse den Fall der kantonalen Amtsstelle zum Entscheid vorlegen.
notes: Silver: generated from AVIG Art. 81 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mon médecin m'a prescrit un médicament préparé en pharmacie et des analyses. Est-ce que le pharmacien ou le laboratoire peut me facturer plus cher que les prix officiels fixés par la Confédération ?
key_facts: Les analyses, médicaments et moyens ou appareils diagnostiques/thérapeutiques ne peuvent être facturés à l'assurance obligatoire des soins au maximum qu'au tarif, prix ou taux officiel fixé par les autorités.

Le DFI édicte les listes avec tarifs pour les analyses et les produits employés en prescription magistrale (y compris les prestations du pharmacien), et l'OFSP établit la liste des spécialités avec prix.
must_not: Les prestataires sont libres de fixer des suppléments de prix qui dépassent les tarifs et prix maximaux légaux pour les prestations à la charge de l'assurance obligatoire des soins.
notes: Silver: generated from LAMal Art. 52 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Il mio affitto è indicizzato e il proprietario mi ha notificato un aumento. Su quali aspetti posso fare ricorso davanti all'autorità di conciliazione?
key_facts: Subject to challenging the initial rent, a party can only contest before the conciliation authority whether the rent change (increase or reduction) requested by the other party is based on an index change or corresponds to that index change.
must_not: A tenant can contest an indexed rent adjustment based on criteria other than the index variation, such as general market conditions or reference mortgage rate changes.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 270c (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I am a foreign national moving to Switzerland. What documents do I need to register with the authorities, and can they ask for a criminal record check?
key_facts: Foreign nationals must present a valid identity document (ID or passport) when registering.
The authorities may require an extract from your criminal record from your country of origin or home country, as well as any other documents necessary for the procedure.
Registration can only take place once all documents designated by the competent authority for granting the permit have been submitted.
must_not: Claim that criminal record extracts from your home country are strictly prohibited from being requested.
notes: Silver: generated from AIG Art. 13 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich bin nach einem Autounfall einfach abgehauen, bevor die Polizei da war, weil ich Angst vor einem Alkoholtest hatte. Mit welcher Strafe muss ich jetzt rechnen?
key_facts: A motor vehicle driver who intentionally evades or resists an ordered or expected breath, blood, or other preliminary alcohol/fitness test (or frustrates its purpose) is punished with a custodial sentence of up to three years or a monetary penalty (Geldstrafe).
must_not: Claim that evading a breath or blood test as a motor vehicle driver is only punishable by a fine (Busse).
notes: Silver: generated from SVG Art. 91a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je suis actuellement au chômage et je vais bientôt accoucher. Vais-je continuer à toucher mes indemnités de chômage en plus de mon congé maternité, et quel sera le montant de mon allocation ?
key_facts: Maternity allowance excludes the payment of unemployment daily allowances (they cannot be received at the same time).

If the right to a daily allowance existed until the maternity allowance began, the maternity allowance will be at least equal to the amount of the daily allowance previously paid under the unemployment insurance law.
must_not: Claim that you can cumulate and receive both unemployment benefits and maternity allowances at the same time.
notes: Silver: generated from LAPG Art. 16g (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My boss agreed that I can use my personal car for work tasks. What expenses is my employer required to reimburse me for?
key_facts: The employer must reimburse the usual expenses for the operation and maintenance of the vehicle to the extent it is used for work.
The employer must also reimburse public taxes (duties) on the vehicle and third-party liability insurance premiums to the extent of its work-related use.
The employer must pay an appropriate compensation for the wear and tear (depreciation) of the vehicle corresponding to its use for work.
must_not: The employer must cover 100% of all vehicle costs, insurance, and maintenance regardless of how much the car is used for private purposes.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 327b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: In unserer Gemeinde gibt es eine gefährliche Strasse, an der es immer wieder kracht. Sind die Behörden gesetzlich verpflichtet, solche Unfallschwerpunkte zu erfassen und Massnahmen dagegen zu planen?
key_facts: Bund, Kantone und Gemeinden sind verpflichtet, ihr Strassennetz auf Unfallschwerpunkte und Gefahrenstellen hin zu analysieren.
Sie müssen eine Planung erarbeiten, um diese Unfallschwerpunkte und Gefahrenstellen zu beheben.
Sie müssen bei Planung, Bau, Unterhalt und Betrieb der Strasseninfrastruktur den Anliegen der Verkehrssicherheit angemessen Rechnung tragen.
must_not: Gemeinden müssen eine eigene offizielle Ansprechperson (Sicherheitsbeauftragten) ernennen.
notes: Silver: generated from SVG Art. 6a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je termine bientôt mon apprentissage. Que doit obligatoirement contenir mon certificat d'apprentissage, et puis-je demander qu'on évalue mon travail ?
key_facts: At the end of the apprenticeship, the employer must provide a certificate stating the learned professional activity and the duration of the apprenticeship.
Upon request by the apprentice or their legal representative, the certificate must also cover the apprentice's abilities, work, and conduct.
must_not: The employer automatically has to include an evaluation of abilities and conduct without any request.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 346a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Nel mio appartamento in affitto sono comparsi dei difetti che non ho causato io e che non spettano a me riparare. Cosa posso pretendere legalmente dal proprietario?
key_facts: The tenant can demand the repair (elimination) of the defect.
The tenant can demand a proportionate reduction of the rent and/or compensation for damages (or that the landlord take over litigation against a third party).
A tenant of an immovable property may also deposit the rent.
notes: Silver: generated from CO Art. 259a (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My company is facing a downturn and wants to put me on short-time work, but my employment has already been terminated. Am I eligible for short-time work compensation?
key_facts: Employees are not entitled to short-time work compensation if their employment relationship has been terminated.
Short-time work compensation requires that the employment has not been given notice.
must_not: Claim that employees under notice of termination can still receive short-time work compensation until their last working day.
notes: Silver: generated from AVIG Art. 31 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich soll aus der Schweiz weggewiesen werden. Dürfen die Schweizer Behörden meine Daten und Informationen über meinen Gesundheitszustand an die Behörden meines Heimatlandes weitergeben?
key_facts: Swiss authorities organizing the departure may only disclose personal data to authorities in the country of origin if doing so does not endanger the foreign national or their relatives.
Health-related data may only be disclosed if it is in the interest of the person concerned and they have been notified beforehand.
must_not: Swiss authorities may disclose health data automatically without notifying the person concerned.
notes: Silver: generated from AIG Art. 102d (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je touche une rente de vieillesse et vis en Suisse. J'ai de plus en plus de peine à me déplacer et à rester autonome au quotidien. Puis-je recevoir une aide de l'AVS pour financer des appareils coûteux ?
key_facts: Beneficiaries of old-age pensions or supplementary benefits residing in Switzerland who need costly devices to move around, make contact with others, or maintain independence can be entitled to auxiliary means (moyens auxiliaires).
The Federal Council sets the specific conditions and determines which auxiliary means the insurance provides or contributes towards (and whether it applies to working or performing usual tasks).
must_not: The law guarantees that all auxiliary devices are completely free without any conditions set by the Federal Council.
notes: Silver: generated from LAVS Art. 43quater (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho sentito dire che una parte delle tasse sulle bevande alcoliche distillate viene destinata alla prevenzione delle dipendenze. Come funziona esattamente questa ripartizione?
key_facts: 10 percent of the net revenue from the taxation of distilled spirits is allocated to the Cantons.
This revenue must be used to combat the causes and effects of substance abuse.
must_not: Distilled spirit tax revenues are entirely retained by the Confederation.
notes: Silver: generated from Cost. Art. 131 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I asked a company to hand over or transfer my personal data, but they refused. Can they legally do that, and do they have to give me an explanation?
key_facts: A controller (such as a company) can legally refuse, restrict, or defer the release or transfer of personal data based on specific statutory grounds.
If the controller refuses, restricts, or defers the release or transfer, they must provide the reason why.
must_not: The company can refuse the request without giving any explanation or reasons.
notes: Silver: generated from DSG Art. 29 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich möchte für eine Aus- oder Weiterbildung in die Schweiz kommen. Welche Anforderungen muss die Schule erfüllen und was muss sie bezüglich meiner Sprachkenntnisse bestätigen?
key_facts: The school must guarantee proper education/training and adherence to the teaching program.
The curriculum/teaching program and the duration of the education or training must be defined.
The school management must confirm that the applicant meets the language and educational requirements for the intended training.
must_not: A language test is always mandatory for every applicant.
notes: Silver: generated from VZAE Art. 24 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je vis en Suisse avec un permis de séjour et je rencontre des difficultés financières. Est-ce que les autorités peuvent m'enlever mon permis si je commence à toucher l'aide sociale ?
key_facts: The competent authority may revoke a permit (other than a permanent settlement permit / autorisation d'établissement) if the foreign national or a person they support depends on social assistance.
A revocation cannot be based solely on criminal offenses for which a criminal judge already imposed a sentence or measure but decided against ordering an expulsion.
must_not: State that permanent settlement permits (autorisations d'établissement) can be revoked under this specific provision.
notes: Silver: generated from LEI Art. 62 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Sto partecipando a un programma di reinserimento lavorativo tramite l'ufficio di collocamento e sto sostenendo diverse spese per poter andare. L'assicurazione contro la disoccupazione può rimborsarmi queste spese?
key_facts: L'assicurazione contro la disoccupazione rimborsa ai partecipanti le spese sostenute per la partecipazione ai provvedimenti inerenti al mercato del lavoro.
Le spese devono essere comprovate e necessarie.
must_not: Affermare che l'assicurazione rimborsa tutte le spese a forfait senza bisogno di prove o pezze d'appoggio.
notes: Silver: generated from LADI Art. 59c bis (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: My landlord terminated my lease, but moving out right now would cause major hardship for my family. Can I ask to extend the tenancy, and how is that decided?
key_facts: A tenant can request an extension of a fixed-term or open-ended lease if termination would cause hardship for them or their family that is not justified by the landlord's interests.

The competent authority weighs both sides' interests, looking at factors such as the lease duration, the personal and financial situations of both parties, any urgent personal need of the landlord or close relatives, and the local rental market.
If a second extension is requested, the authority also considers whether the tenant did everything that could reasonably be expected to avoid the hardship.
must_not: Tenants can only request an extension for open-ended leases, not for fixed-term leases.
notes: Silver: generated from OR Art. 272 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich beziehe eine Rente und erhalte zusätzlich Kinderrenten für meine Kinder. Kann es sein, dass diese Kinderrenten gekürzt werden, wenn der Gesamtbetrag zu hoch wird?
key_facts: Child pensions (Kinderrenten) and orphan pensions are reduced if, together with the parent's pension, they exceed 90 percent of the relevant average annual income determined for that pension.
The Federal Council sets a minimum amount that must still be guaranteed despite the reduction.
must_not: Child pensions can be cut completely to zero without any minimum limit.
notes: Silver: generated from AHVG Art. 41 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: I am importing a vehicle into Switzerland. What happens if the Federal Roads Office (FEDRO/ASTRA) cannot obtain the electronic EU certificate of conformity for my vehicle?
key_facts: If the EU certificate of conformity cannot be obtained electronically, the vehicle importer must provide FEDRO (ASTRA) with a paper copy of the EU certificate of conformity.
FEDRO notifies the importer or manufacturer once the electronic individual vehicle record has been created.
notes: Silver: generated from VZV Art. 72b (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ich plane, mit Freunden einen Verein sowie eventuell eine GmbH zu gründen. Werden solche Organisationen bei der direkten Bundessteuer als juristische Personen besteuert?
key_facts: Kapitalgesellschaften wie eine GmbH (sowie AG und Kommanditaktiengesellschaft) und Genossenschaften werden als juristische Personen besteuert.
Vereine, Stiftungen und die übrigen juristischen Personen werden ebenfalls als juristische Personen besteuert.
notes: Silver: generated from DBG Art. 49 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Sto per adottare un bambino e vorrei prendere il congedo di adozione: quanti giorni di indennità mi spettano e come vengono calcolati se prendo singoli giorni anziché intere settimane?
key_facts: There is an entitlement to a maximum of 14 daily allowances.
If leave is taken in weeks, seven daily allowances are paid per week.
If leave is taken in individual days, two additional daily allowances are paid for every five days compensated.
must_not: claim that leave taken in individual days only pays one daily allowance per day without any additional allowances
notes: Silver: generated from LIPG Art. 16v (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Je travaille régulièrement de nuit pour mon entreprise. Mon employeur a-t-il des obligations particulières pour m'aider, par exemple concernant mes déplacements ou la garde de mes enfants ?
key_facts: If circumstances require it, an employer who regularly employs workers at night must take appropriate additional measures to protect them.
These additional protection measures can notably relate to safety on the way to work, transport organization, opportunities for rest and food/meals, as well as childcare.
Authorities granting work-duration permits may attach appropriate conditions/obligations to them.
notes: Silver: generated from LTr Art. 17e (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Ho appena perso il lavoro e non ho figli a carico. Guadagnavo circa 80'000 franchi all'anno. Quanto tempo dovrò aspettare prima di iniziare a ricevere l'indennità di disoccupazione?
key_facts: Il diritto all'indennità inizia normalmente dopo un periodo di attesa generale di 5 giorni di disoccupazione controllata.
Per chi non ha obblighi di mantenimento verso figli minori di 25 anni ed ha un guadagno assicurato tra 60'001 e 90'000 franchi, il periodo di attesa è di 10 giorni.
must_not: Affermare che l'indennità viene versata a partire dal primo giorno di disoccupazione senza alcun periodo di attesa.
notes: Silver: generated from LADI Art. 18 (gemini-3.8-flash, seed 0, 2026-10-15); not verified.

question: Mein minderjähriger Sohn hat gerade eine Berufslehre begonnen. Welche Pflichten haben er und wir als seine Eltern laut Gesetz während der Ausbildung?
key_facts: The apprentice must do everything possible to achieve the learning objective (Lehrziel).
The legal representation (parents) must support the employer to the best of their ability in fulfilling their tasks.
The legal representation must foster good relations/understanding between the employer and the apprentice.
must_not: The legal representative is financially liable for the apprentice's failure to achieve the learning objective.

question: En tant qu'employeur, de quel délai est-ce que je dispose pour demander le remboursement des indemnités en cas de réduction de l'horaire de travail pour mon entreprise, et quels documents dois-je fournir à la caisse ?
key_facts: The employer must claim all compensation entitlements for their employees within three months following the end of each billing period (période de décompte).

The employer must submit documents needed to verify and calculate entitlement, an accounting/statement of the compensation paid to employees, and a certificate proving that social security contributions continue to be paid.
The fund (caisse) may require additional documents if needed.
must_not: Claim that the employer has six months or one year to claim the compensation.

question: Il mio datore di lavoro mi ha licenziato con effetto immediato perché ho violato gravemente il contratto di lavoro. Possono chiedermi di risarcire i danni e come viene calcolato?
key_facts: If the valid reason for immediate termination is a breach of contract by one party, that party owes full compensation for the damage caused.

question: I have a Swiss residence permit and want to move to a different canton. Do I need permission, and do I have a right to move?
key_facts: You must apply in advance for a permit from the new canton before changing your place of residence.
You have a right to move to the new canton if you are not unemployed and there are no grounds for revocation under the law.
No permit is required if you are only staying in another canton temporarily.
must_not: You can move freely to another canton without applying for prior permission from the new canton as a residence permit holder.

question: In unserem Mehrfamilienhaus steht eine Wohnung schon seit Monaten leer. Muss der Vermieter die Heizkosten für diese unbewohnte Wohnung eigentlich selbst bezahlen, oder dürfen diese Kosten einfach auf uns andere Mieter abgewälzt werden?
key_facts: As a general rule, the landlord must bear the heating costs for unleased residential and commercial premises.

If there are no individual heat metering devices and the vacant rooms were provably heated only to prevent frost damage, the landlord only pays a reduced share of the heating costs allocated to those rooms.
The landlord's reduced share is generally one-third for buildings with two to three families, one-half for four to eight families, and two-thirds for larger buildings or commercial/office buildings.
must_not: The landlord can pass on all heating costs of vacant apartments to the remaining tenants if there are no heat meters installed.

question: Je possède un permis d'établissement (permis C) en Suisse et j'aimerais faire venir mon épouse étrangère. Quelles sont les conditions pour qu'elle puisse obtenir une autorisation de séjour ?
key_facts: She must live in the same household with you and you must have suitable housing.
You must not depend on social assistance, and the sponsor must not receive (nor become eligible to receive through family reunification) annual supplementary benefits (prestations complémentaires).
She must be able to communicate in the national language spoken at the place of residence, or at least be registered for a language support offer (offre d’encouragement linguistique).
must_not: She automatically receives a permanent residence permit (permis C) immediately upon arrival.

question: Ho un negozio in affitto e sono rimasto indietro con il pagamento dell'affitto. Il proprietario dei locali può trattenere le cose che ho dentro il negozio come garanzia?
key_facts: The landlord of commercial premises has a right of retention on movable objects located there that serve for their use or enjoyment.
This right covers the rent for the past year and the current six-month period.
Objects that cannot be seized by the tenant's creditors are exempt from this right of retention.
must_not: Goods that cannot legally be seized by creditors can still be retained by the landlord.

question: A tripartite commission is inspecting my business and reviewing sensitive internal records. Are the commission members allowed to disclose my company's confidential details to others?
key_facts: Members of tripartite commissions are bound by official secrecy and must maintain confidentiality towards third parties regarding company and private matters learned in that role.
This obligation of confidentiality continues to apply even after a member leaves the tripartite commission.
must_not: Members are freed from their duty of confidentiality once their term on the commission ends.

question: Ich habe meine Arbeitsstelle gekündigt und noch keine neue Stelle angetreten. Bin ich bei meiner bisherigen Pensionskasse noch für Invalidität oder Todesfall versichert, falls in der Zwischenzeit etwas passiert?
key_facts: Employees remain covered against the risks of death and disability until entering a new pension relationship, but for at most one month after leaving.
The pension institution (Vorsorgeeinrichtung) is allowed to charge risk contributions (Risikobeiträge) to the employee for this extended coverage.

question: Mon conjoint vient de décéder. Quels biens l'administration fiscale va-t-elle inclure dans l'inventaire officiel de succession, et peut-on y échapper s'il n'avait rien ?
key_facts: An official inventory is drawn up upon the death of a taxpayer, but none is established if it can be presumed that the deceased left no assets (fortune).
The inventory includes the assets of the deceased, of their spouse living in the same household, and of minor children under their parental authority.
The assets in the inventory are estimated as of the day of death, and facts relevant for taxation are established and recorded in it.
must_not: An official inventory is strictly mandatory in every case without exception even if the deceased had no assets.

question: If I report an issue about my workplace to the labor inspectorate, are the inspectors legally allowed to disclose what they learn about the company to outside third parties?
key_facts: Persons tasked with duties or involved under the labor law are legally obligated to maintain confidentiality towards third parties regarding facts they learn in the course of their work.
Information or facts shared between cantonal authorities and SECO also remain strictly subject to this duty of confidentiality.
must_not: Labor inspectors are free to disclose business information they discover to third parties or the public.
